findings.claim: Bypass-gate regex `D-0[0-9]{3}` in WP-SCP-020 plan §4 020B(viii-c) — echoed verbatim in the 020K DISPATCH-NOTE.md verification criteria — does not match any existing or current D-NNN decision ID and will cause all break-glass bypass attempts to fail if the script is implemented per spec.
findings.evidence: All entries in docs/DECISIONS.md follow the `D-NNN` three-digit convention (D-001..D-031). The regex `D-0[0-9]{3}` requires the literal string `D-0` followed by exactly three more digits, i.e. D-0000..D-0999 (four-digit IDs). Applied to D-031: `D-0` matches `D-0`, then `[0-9]{3}` requires three more digits but only `31` (two chars) then a space is available — the match fails. The same applies to every ID in the table including D-001..D-020 range cited in the plan as the verification baseline: e.g. D-020 = `D-0` + `20` (two chars), not three. The plan annotation `'verified against current docs/DECISIONS.md shape at D-001..D-020'` is therefore incorrect — none of those IDs satisfy the regex. The 020K dispatch note at `docs/reviews/WP-SCP-022/dispatches/020k/DISPATCH-NOTE.md` reproduces the same regex as item (3) in its D-031 verification checklist.
findings.impact: If `scripts/verify-bypass-pairing.sh` (specified in plan §4 020B(viii-c)) is implemented using this regex exactly, the bypass-gate grep will never find a matching D-NNN row in `docs/DECISIONS.md`. Every break-glass bypass attempt will emit SCP-E004 and block merge regardless of the presence of a valid D-NNN record and waivers.json entry. The bypass mechanism is inoperative under the spec as written. Additionally the 020K dispatch note's own verification criterion for D-031 fails, meaning automated validation of this dispatch artefact would incorrectly reject a well-formed row.
findings.mitigation: Fix the regex to `^\|\s*D-[0-9]{3}\s*\|\s*20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\s*\|` (remove the literal `0` between `D-` and `[0-9]{3}`) in: (1) plan §4 020B(viii-c) script specification; (2) any existing implementation of `scripts/verify-bypass-pairing.sh` — grep the file for the current broken string before the next bypass is exercised; (3) the 020K dispatch note verification criteria. The corrected regex matches D-001..D-999 and satisfies all current and anticipated D-NNN IDs.
